primary.title: Using ChatGPT, Gemini for money advice? Think twice before creating a detailed prompt | What not to reveal
primary.summary: AI chatbots can assist with financial advice but should not replace professional guidance. Their effectiveness depends on user prompts; poor questions may lead to inaccurate responses.
